concept.title: Getting started
concept.shortdesc: OpenV is a requirements management platform with full traceability, verification & validation (V&V) tracking, and a built-in multi-agent suite. This chapter gets you from the sign-in screen to your first workspace.

conbody.p: To watch a project go from nothing to its first baseline, see the getting-started video on openv.app: two minutes, with captions and a transcript.
